title: FAQ Page
content: Build FAQ page with organized questions. Header: search input to filter FAQs. Categories: sidebar or horizontal tabs (Getting Started, Billing, Features, etc.). Question list: accordion style with plus/minus icons. Answer content: supports rich text, links, code snippets. Helpful? thumbs up/down feedback. Related questions. Contact support section at bottom if question not answered.

variants.simple: Create FAQ page with categorized questions and accordion answers.
variants.detailed: Build FAQ page with organized questions. Header: search input to filter FAQs. Categories: sidebar or horizontal tabs (Getting Started, Billing, Features, etc.). Question list: accordion style with plus/minus icons. Answer content: supports rich text, links, code snippets. Helpful? thumbs up/down feedback. Related questions. Contact support section at bottom if question not answered.
variants.advanced: Build comprehensive FAQ page with search and categorization. Page header: "Frequently Asked Questions" (text-4xl font-bold text-center), subheadline. Search section: large search input (max-w-2xl mx-auto), placeholder "Search for answers...", Search icon inside, clear X when has value, real-time filtering of questions, highlight matched terms in results. Category navigation: horizontal tabs (md:) or dropdown (mobile) or sidebar (lg:). Categories: Getting Started, Account & Billing, Features, Troubleshooting, Privacy & Security, API, etc. Active category: underline or bg styling. "All" option to show all. FAQ list: max-w-3xl mx-auto, space-y-4. Accordion item: bg-white rounded-lg shadow-sm border. Question row: flex justify-between items-center p-4 cursor-pointer hover:bg-gray-50. Question text: font-medium. Toggle icon: ChevronDown (rotates 180deg when open) or Plus/Minus. Answer panel: px-4 pb-4 pt-0, prose styling for rich text content. Support markdown or HTML: paragraphs, links (text-blue-600 hover:underline), ordered/unordered lists, code blocks (bg-gray-100 rounded px-2 py-1 font-mono), images if applicable. Animation: max-height transition or Framer Motion for smooth expand/collapse. Multiple open: allow multiple questions open simultaneously (or single). Helpful feedback: at bottom of each answer, "Was this helpful?" with thumbs up/down buttons, track for analytics, show "Thank you" after vote. Related questions: "Related articles" section below each answer with 2-3 links. Deep linking: each question has anchor ID, URL updates on open, direct link to specific question. Not found section: after FAQ list, "Didn't find what you were looking for?" with contact support button and live chat option. Popular questions: optional "Most Asked" section at top with top 5 questions. Search results: when searching, show filtered questions with match highlighting, "No results for [query]" if none. Structured data: add FAQ schema for SEO. Mobile: collapsible category menu, full-width accordions. Accessibility: accordion follows WAI-ARIA pattern, buttons for toggle, aria-expanded state, proper heading levels.
